answerSection.methodBasis: Basis — the headline years figure is computed at the median, volatility-drag-adjusted return: exp(ln(1+r) − σ²/2) − 1, not the raw expected return.
answerSection.methodLikelyRange: Likely range — the 25th–75th percentile of crossing time: the year at which there is a 25%/75% probability the portfolio's value AT THAT TIME is at or above the goal. This is not first-passage time (the first time the portfolio ever touches the goal, which is always earlier).
answerSection.methodApproximation: It is an analytic approximation pinned to a 20,000-path Monte Carlo, not an exact confidence interval — typically 5–9% off at the tails, which is why the range is rounded to one decimal.
answerSection.methodLiquidNw: Liquid NW excludes property, insurance, and pension.
answerSection.goalNotReachable: Goal not reachable on current inputs
answerSection.likelyRange: likely range {{low}}–{{high}} — 25th to 75th percentile crossing time

kpi.savingsRateTooltip: Savings rate — everything you did not spend: (income − expenses) ÷ income, over the trailing 12 data months of the Income & Expense ledger. Income basis excludes redemptions and the reimbursements/work-expenses round trip; expenses exclude money invested.
kpi.investmentRateTooltip: Investment rate — the share of income that actually reached an investment account: (net new external money + retained RSU) ÷ the same income basis. The gap to the savings rate is cash saved but not yet deployed.
kpi.undeployedCashTooltip: Saved but not yet deployed — the savings rate and the investment rate expressed as money: income − expenses − (net new external + retained RSU), same trailing 12 data months.

monthlyAttribution.contributionsNote: Portfolio contributions & savings come from your monthly Investment ledger (Income & Expense classification); the flow tags below are the per-transaction view.

waterfall.title: Waterfall
waterfall.description: Start/End = total market value at the month boundaries. Residual = the part of the change NOT explained by price, trades, transfers, or income — usually a data-coverage gap (a snapshot that predates late-month trades, a source transition, or an asset first seen this month). Hover a DQ badge in the table for the per-asset reason.
